name: LatentBlend (core)
plain: Straight linear mix of two latents. The weight runs the opposite way from what many expect: blend_factor is the weight of samples1. Only the "normal" mode exists and the node exposes no mode widget.
math:
out = s1·f + s2·(1−f)
if shapes differ s2 goes through bicubic center-crop common_upscale first.
Variance is not corrected; for independent latents it shrinks by f²+(1−f)².
label: from code
surprise: The samples2.permute calls at nodes.py:1517 and 1519 discard their result, so they do nothing.
